title: "`r params$title`"

output:

    toc: true

header-includes:
  - \usepackage{booktabs}
  - \usepackage{longtable}

params:
  ec: NULL
  lf: NULL
  title: "SEAPODYM fisheries"
  years: NULL
  species: ""
  ec_file: ""
  lf_file: ""
---

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, fig.align = "center",
					  dev = "png", dpi = 150)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(seafisheries)

ec <- params$ec
lf <- params$lf
sp <- if (nzchar(params$species)) paste0(params$species, " ") else ""
if (!is.null(params$years)) {
	ec <- ec |> filter(yr >= params$years[1], yr <= params$years[2])
	if (!is.null(lf)) lf$samples <- lf$samples |> filter(yr >= params$years[1], yr <= params$years[2])
}
years_txt <- if (is.null(params$years)) "all years" else paste(params$years, collapse = "-")

# fishery labels: number and gear code of the catch-effort file
gears <- ec |> distinct(f, gr) |> group_by(f) |>
	summarise(gr = paste(sort(unique(gr)), collapse = "/"), .groups = "drop") |> arrange(f)
flab <- setNames(paste0(gears$gr, gears$f), gears$f)   # gear code + fishery number: L1, G15, D17
fishLabel <- function(f) {
	out <- flab[as.character(f)]
	ifelse(is.na(out), paste0("F", f), out)
}

tab <- function(x, caption) {
	t <- knitr::kable(x, format = "latex", booktabs = TRUE, caption = caption, label = NA,
					  linesep = "", longtable = nrow(x) > 25, position = if (nrow(x) > 25) "" else "H",
					  format.args = list(big.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE))
	knitr::asis_output(paste0("\n```{=latex}\n", as.character(t), "\n```\n"))
}

lf_height <- 3
map_xlim <- range(ec$lon) + c(-3, 3)
map_ylim <- range(ec$lat) + c(-3, 3)
```

Catch-effort file: `r basename(params$ec_file)`.
`r if (nzchar(params$lf_file)) paste0("Length-frequency file: ", basename(params$lf_file), ".")`
Years: `r years_txt`. Catch in mt.

```{r overview}
ov <- ec |> group_by(f) |>
	summarise(records = n(), effort = round(sum(E)), `catch (mt)` = round(sum(C), 1),
			  years = paste(range(yr), collapse = "-"), .groups = "drop")
if (!is.null(lf)) {
	cnt <- lf$samples[, grepl("^L[0-9.]+$", names(lf$samples)), drop = FALSE]
	ov <- ov |> left_join(data.frame(f = lf$samples$f, fish = rowSums(cnt)) |>
						  	group_by(f) |> summarise(length_samples = n(), fish_measured = round(sum(fish)), .groups = "drop"),
						  by = "f") |>
		mutate(across(c(length_samples, fish_measured), ~ tidyr::replace_na(.x, 0)))
}
ov <- ov |> mutate(fishery = fishLabel(f), .before = 1) |> select(-f)
names(ov) <- gsub("_", " ", names(ov))
tab(ov, "Fisheries in the files")
```

# CPUE maps

CPUE per cell: total catch / total effort of the cell. Colour scale per map,
capped to the 5th-95th percentiles; grey: effort without catch. Fisheries
without effort are shown as catch maps.

```{r cpue_maps, fig.width = 7, fig.height = 2.9}
for (k in gears$f) {
	d <- ec |> filter(f == k) |>
		group_by(lat, lon, res) |>
		summarise(C = sum(C), E = sum(E), .groups = "drop")
	no_effort <- sum(d$E) == 0
	if (no_effort) {
		d$value <- d$C
		lims <- quantile(d$value[d$value > 0], c(0.05, 0.95), names = FALSE)
		ttl <- paste0(fishLabel(k), ": catch (no effort)")
		lab <- paste0(sp, "catch (mt)")
	} else {
		d <- d |> filter(E > 0) |> mutate(value = C / E)
		lims <- quantile(d$value[d$value > 0], c(0.05, 0.95), names = FALSE)
		ttl <- paste0(fishLabel(k), ": CPUE")
		lab <- paste0(sp, "CPUE")
	}
	if (!length(lims) || any(is.na(lims)) || lims[1] == lims[2]) lims <- NULL
	d$plot <- ifelse(d$value > 0, if (is.null(lims)) d$value else pmin(pmax(d$value, lims[1]), lims[2]), NA)
	p <- ggplot(d) +
		geom_tile(aes(x = lon, y = lat, fill = plot, width = res, height = res)) +
		map_bg() +
		scale_fill_viridis_c(name = lab, limits = lims, na.value = "grey75") +
		coord_labels() +
		coord_fixed(xlim = map_xlim, ylim = map_ylim) +
		labs(title = ttl) +
		customTheme(9) +
		theme(legend.position = "right", legend.key.height = unit(0.8, "cm"))
	print(p)
}
```

# Catch and effort

Annual totals per fishery.

```{r catch_effort, fig.width = 7, fig.height = 2.9}
yrs <- seq(min(ec$yr), max(ec$yr))
for (k in gears$f) {
	d <- ec |> filter(f == k) |>
		group_by(yr) |> summarise(catch = sum(C), effort = sum(E), .groups = "drop") |>
		complete(yr = yrs)   # NA: no record that year (gaps in the lines)
	vars <- if (sum(d$effort, na.rm = TRUE) == 0) "catch" else c("catch", "effort")
	d <- d |> pivot_longer(c(catch, effort), names_to = "var") |>
		filter(var %in% vars) |>
		mutate(var = factor(var, levels = c("catch", "effort"),
							labels = c(paste0(sp, "catch (mt)"), "effort")))
	p <- ggplot(d, aes(yr, value)) +
		geom_line(na.rm = TRUE) + geom_point(size = 0.6, na.rm = TRUE) +
		facet_wrap(~ var, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y", strip.position = "left") +
		scale_x_continuous(limits = range(yrs)) +
		scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_comma()) +
		labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, title = fishLabel(k)) +
		customTheme(9) +
		theme(strip.placement = "outside")
	print(p)
}
```

```{r lf_check, results = "asis"}
if (is.null(lf)) cat("\n\nNo length-frequency file given.\n")
```

```{r lf_data, eval = !is.null(lf)}
bin_cols <- grep("^L[0-9.]+$", names(lf$samples), value = TRUE)
lfl <- lf$samples |>
	select(f, all_of(bin_cols)) |>
	group_by(f) |> summarise(across(everything(), sum), .groups = "drop") |>
	pivot_longer(-f, names_to = "bin", values_to = "n") |>
	mutate(len = as.numeric(sub("^L", "", bin)))
stats <- lfl |> group_by(f) |>
	arrange(len, .by_group = TRUE) |>
	summarise(fish = sum(n),
			  mode = len[which.max(n)],
			  median = len[which(cumsum(n) >= sum(n) / 2)[1]],
			  mean = sum(len * n) / sum(n), .groups = "drop") |>
	mutate(label = sprintf("mode %g\nmedian %g\nmean %.1f", mode, median, mean),
		   panel = paste0(fishLabel(f), ", ", format(round(fish), big.mark = ","), " fish"))
lfl <- lfl |> left_join(stats |> select(f, fish, panel), by = "f") |>
	mutate(prop = n / fish, panel = factor(panel, levels = stats$panel))
stats$panel <- factor(stats$panel, levels = stats$panel)
n_panel <- nrow(stats)
lf_height <- max(3, 1.5 * ceiling(n_panel / 3) + 0.8)
```

`r if (!is.null(lf)) "# Length distributions"`

`r if (!is.null(lf)) paste0("Share of the fish per length bin (", lf$bins[2] - lf$bins[1], " cm), all samples of the fishery summed.")`

```{r lf_plot, eval = !is.null(lf), fig.width = 7.5, fig.height = lf_height}
ggplot(lfl, aes(len, prop)) +
	geom_col(width = lf$bins[2] - lf$bins[1], fill = "grey40") +
	geom_vline(data = stats, aes(xintercept = median), colour = "firebrick", linewidth = 0.3) +
	geom_text(data = stats, aes(x = Inf, y = Inf, label = label),
			  hjust = 1.05, vjust = 1.2, size = 2.4, lineheight = 0.9) +
	facet_wrap(~ panel, ncol = 3, scales = "free_y") +
	labs(x = "length (cm)", y = "share of fish") +
	customTheme(8)
```
